title: Requests
description: Everything clients and teammates have asked for, in one queue.
newDescription: File a request on behalf of a client, or raise one for your own team.
noFormsHint: An owner or admin can create a request form in Settings → Request forms.
emptyHint: Requests arrive from the client portal, or you can file one here on a client's behalf.
emptyFilteredHint: Try a request number, or fewer words.

emptyView.open: No open requests. The queue is clear.
emptyView.mine: You don't own any open requests.
emptyView.submitted: Nothing new is waiting for triage.
emptyView.needs_info: Nobody is waiting on an answer from a client.
emptyView.in_review: Nothing is in review right now.

fields.clientHint: Leave empty for an internal request.
fields.title: Title
fields.detailsHint: What is being asked for, and why.

threadHintClient: Replies marked “visible to client” reach the requester in the portal. Internal notes stay with your team.
threadHintInternal: This request has no client account, so the whole thread is internal.

triage.title: Status
triage.hint: Moving a request notifies the person who submitted it.
triage.closedHint: This request is closed. Reopen it by asking for info or accepting it again from the portal thread.
triage.needsInfoBody: Your message is posted in the thread for the client, and the request waits on their reply.
triage.needsInfoBodyInternal: Your message is posted in the thread and the request waits on a reply.
triage.messageLabel: What do you need to know?
triage.messageRequired: Write what you need to know first.
triage.declineBody: The reason is shown to the requester, so write it for them.
triage.reasonRequired: Tell the requester why this was declined.

convert.title: Turn into work
convert.hint: Keeps the request's text, answers and a link back.
convert.noProjects: You don't have a project to put a task in yet.
convert.closedHint: Closed requests aren't converted. Reopen it first.
convert.taskBody: The new task carries the request's details and answers in its description.
convert.share: Share the task with the client
convert.shareHint: They'll see its status and comments marked visible to them.
convert.keepsContext: The request moves to “In progress” and completes when the task does.
convert.projectTitle: Start a project from this request
convert.projectBody: A new project for the same client, with this request as its starting brief.
convert.projectKeyHint: 2–6 letters or digits, used in task IDs.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.dialogBody: Find the request this one repeats. This one closes and links to it.
duplicate.searchPrompt: Search to pick the original request.
duplicate.confirmBody: This request closes with a link to the original. The requester is told.
